nodes.name: Webhook (slot cancelled)
nodes.notes: Fired by trg_notify_n8n_slot_cancelled. Payload: { type:'slot_cancelled', slot_id, clinic_id, start_time }. After activating, set private.app_config.n8n_cascade_webhook_url to this node's Production URL.

nodes.name: cascade_offer_next
nodes.notes: Fat RPC: picks the single best candidate, writes the cascade_offer + conversation, returns a status envelope. status='offer' means we have someone to text; anything else (noop/cutoff/exhausted/no_candidates) ends the run.

nodes.name: Got a candidate?
nodes.notes: True -> generate + send the offer. False -> stop (slot stays cancelled; a later decline/expiry sweep may re-post it).

nodes.name: agent_context
nodes.notes: Reused from WF-A. Gives us clinic_name + patient for the persona. The conversation has no messages yet — this is agent-initiated.

nodes.name: Build offer prompt
nodes.notes: Formats the freed/candidate times in Europe/Lisbon and assembles the system + user prompts. No medical data leaves the DB — only names + times.

nodes.name: agent_send_message
nodes.notes: Posts the offer with the service_role key -> lands in the /sms thread and staff /conversations console. Won't re-trigger n8n (agent messages don't fire the inbound trigger).
